instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
While the water heats up, wash, dry, and trim the green beans. Place in a large bowl.

Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and green beans, and stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 3-4 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots and garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, and almonds; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
⅓ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Add drained green beans, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are warmed through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry lemon. When the green beans are done, zest and juice lemon into the skillet, then stir to combine.
